summary: Verified INV-1 extractor tuning + refund/letter/CSV UX. Backend: on the Glorious Services INV-2026-07-4471 sample, extractor now yields 29 line items (target ≥25) and reconciliation.findings returns 7 findings including C1, C6 (x2), C8, C10, C11 (x2) — target ≥5 with C6/C8/C10/C11 all present. Both C6 findings expose a numeric observed.difference ($24.15 and $12.00). Frontend: /app/invoices shows 'Export CSV' button beside 'Check a new invoice'; clicking it downloads wayly-invoices-2026-08-12.csv with the exact expected 10-column header and one row per invoice (23 rows). Invoice detail page shows Draft-letter buttons per finding (data-testid inv1-issue-letter-N); clicking one navigates to /app/letters?compose=1&source_type=inv1_finding&... with subject/body/source_id/provider_name pre-seeded. Financial-impact accumulator works: on the Meridian sample opened for regression, 3 C2 findings each contributed $44.30 REFUND labels and the summary banner's Potential refund equalled $132.90 = 3×$44.30 (no double counting).
critical_code_review_comments: InvoicesList.downloadInvoicesCsv joins with \r\n and wraps in a Blob — this works but the browser may normalise to \n on some platforms; not a bug, just noting the split logic in tests must handle both.

Upload response does not return the extracted line_items array — tests had to re-run extract_line_items on the persisted payable_section to count lines. Consider surfacing total_line_items in the upload response for observability.
C6 finding message currently reads generic 'Line arithmetic differs by …' — consider naming after-hours vs. sum-mismatch variants so users understand why (nice-to-have).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded the Glorious Services INV-2026-07-4471 sample PDF (via /api/invoices/upload) 3 times during backend tests. No cleanup performed — invoices remain in cathy's household.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_inv1_iter136_tuning.py fetches the Glorious PDF from the customer-assets URL every run; it is idempotent and can be re-run. Login response key is 'token' (not 'access_token') and password-based login is at /login with data-testid=login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Extracted line items are not returned by /api/invoices/upload or GET /api/invoices/{id} — to count, call lib.inv1.extractor.extract_line_items on doc.payable_section directly.
rca of the issue: n/a — all four follow-ups pass end-to-end.
